# Library search (fused retrieval)

_sequence · source: `docs/atlas/views/sequence/library-search.yaml`_

One search box, four independent channels. Each channel decides its own membership (a calibrated semantic cutoff, Bleve OCR matching, FTS place matching, filename matching); weighted reciprocal-rank fusion merges them and the fused set is the result. Search degrades gracefully when Lumen is unavailable.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant n_web as Assets search (Web)
    participant n_handler as AssetHandler
    participant n_service as AssetService
    participant n_semantic as Embedding retriever
    participant n_lumen as Lumen Hub
    participant n_vec as Vec1 vector index
    participant n_ocr as Bleve OCR retriever
    participant n_place as Place retriever (FTS5)
    participant n_catalog as Catalog reader
    n_web->>n_handler: POST /assets/search {query, filter}
    n_handler->>n_service: SearchAssets
    par every channel is self-thresholded
        n_service->>n_semantic: RetrieveSet (calibrated cutoff)
        n_semantic->>n_lumen: embed query text
        n_semantic->>n_vec: KNN in the active embedding space, cosine floor
    and OCR
        n_service->>n_ocr: strict-then-relaxed Bleve match
    and place
        n_service->>n_place: FTS match on place names
    and filename
        n_service->>n_catalog: filename match, one primary per media item
    end
    n_service->>n_service: weighted RRF (semantic 1.0, place 0.8, OCR 0.7, filename 0.6)
    n_service->>n_catalog: hydrate ranked Assets in the requested lifecycle state
    n_handler-->>n_web: best results (top-N by confidence) + full set under the chosen sort
```

## No TopK anywhere

The fused set is the answer; "best results" is a confidence-ordered subset of it, and the results tier is the same set under the requested sort. Each channel only has a large safety cap.

## Degradation

If Lumen is not configured or fails, the semantic channel is skipped and the response is flagged `semantic_unavailable`; OCR, place, and filename matches still answer.
